summary: The diff shows substantial progress toward the BuildRequest requirements. Nearly all features have frontend scaffolding or hooks, backend types are present in main.mo and migration.mo, and the router includes new pages. However, implementation is incomplete for most requirements: mock data and placeholder logic dominate, backend queries/mutations are missing or shallow, and advanced features like relevance scoring, distance sorting, and featured listing backend logic are not fully connected. Several requirements lack evidence of working end-to-end flows.

missing_requirements.requirement: Analytics dashboard with interactive charts for time ranges (7, 30, 90 days) displaying sales trends, view counts, and engagement metrics
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend components use generateMockSalesData and generateMockViewData with no backend integration. useGetInsightsAnalytics hook exists but backend query is not shown in diff. Mock data generation does not match real analytics logic.

missing_requirements.requirement: Relevance sort uses scoring algorithm based on user signals
missing_requirements.reason: Diff shows no implementation of relevance scoring algorithm or user signals collection (views, saves, transaction count). SortOption types may exist but scoring logic is missing.

missing_requirements.requirement: Distance sort calculates proximity to user's campus location
missing_requirements.reason: No distance calculation logic, geolocation API usage, or proximity scoring appears in the diff. LocationDetail type exists but no distance sorting implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin or sellers can mark listings as featured through backend
missing_requirements.reason: No backend mutation or admin role logic for marking listings as featured. ListingCard has optional featured styling but no evidence of backend query or update function.

missing_requirements.requirement: Featured listings rotate or display in priority order
missing_requirements.reason: No rotation logic or priority ordering algorithm visible in diff. Featured section placement is suggested but implementation details missing.

missing_requirements.requirement: After completing a transaction, buyers can submit a rating (1-5 stars) and optional review text
missing_requirements.reason: SubmitReviewModal exists but no transaction completion hook or flow that triggers review submission. No backend mutation call evidence for addSellerReview in transaction context.

missing_requirements.requirement: Reputation score updates immediately after new review submission
missing_requirements.reason: Review hooks invalidate queries but no evidence of reputation score recalculation logic in backend or immediate UI update for seller profiles.

missing_requirements.requirement: Key attributes shown in comparison view include seller ratings and meetup locations
missing_requirements.reason: ComparisonPage.tsx truncated but visible code shows only basic card structure. No seller rating or meetup location rendering logic confirmed in diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Recently viewed items persist across browser sessions
missing_requirements.reason: RecentlyViewedPage uses getRecentlyViewed from persistence module but no evidence of localStorage/sessionStorage implementation or cross-session persistence logic in diff.
